caption: The drawing features a symmetrical design composed primarily of three distinct elements centered vertically on a tan background. At the top, there is a stylized cross with flared, rounded ends, rendered in yellow with an outer red border and light blue internal decorative patterns; subtle yellow lines radiate outward from the cross, suggesting a glow. Beneath the cross is a bow-like motif with four petal-shaped loops, each outlined in blue and filled with a yellow center and a red border decorated with small blue dots, converging at a circular blue-and-red center that has a yellow cross pattern. Extending from either side of the central motif are two wing-like shapes in yellow, each with two red teardrop marks at the tips. At the bottom of the composition is a large circular element bordered in red, filled with an intricate pattern of concentric shapes and repeating rays in yellow, blue, and red. The entire design is outlined and highlighted in contrasting colors (red, blue, yellow), and the elements are arranged symmetrically around the central vertical axis. At the bottom center of the image is a typed label describing the origin of the design, and additional text labels appear in the bottom corners.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
